lines.speaker: schoolteacher
lines.text: True. No. False. No. ONE. ZER—

lines.speaker: sweep
lines.text: That's my sentence! From her board! It WORKS!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the gallery, Smudge stares at the floor. His sentence. Her board.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her mask slides off. Under it: a crowned imp. Her own tired eyes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her black scarf falls. It never moved in the wind. It's my shadow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Round the tables, more masks drop. Imps in borrowed faces. Nudge's too.

lines.speaker: nudge
lines.text: My mask! Forty villagers trusted that face! I COUNTED!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And out of Nudge's mask tumbles my first piece.

lines.speaker: schoolteacher
lines.text: Forty years I marked "maybe" wrong. Red ink. Every child.

lines.speaker: schoolteacher
lines.text: If "maybe" was allowed… I was cruel for forty years.

lines.speaker: schoolteacher
lines.text: So when a voice offered me a world with no maybes… I said yes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Constable Clobber takes off his helmet. He hands you her charm and her glasses.

lines.speaker: granny
lines.text: Not a drop on me. But leeks? In MY soup? Here, dear. My Spare Axiom.

lines.speaker: granny
lines.text: I smell of leek. Tell no one. Tell everyone. Here: my Spare Axiom.

lines.speaker: granny
lines.text: Somebody boiled my shawl. Rude. Your card was in the pocket.

lines.speaker: granny
lines.text: My shawl boiled away. With your card in the pocket.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She steps up onto the window. The Sky Rift glows behind her.

lines.speaker: schoolteacher
lines.text: Tomorrow is waiting. Everyone there has already decided about you.

lines.speaker: algorithm
lines.text: "SEE? SHE'S ON MY SIDE." SHE WAS. MY SIDE.

lines.speaker: algorithm
lines.text: THE NEXT ERA WILL BE… probably— LOUDER.
